definitions: A parasitic flatworm, typically having a flattened, leaf-like body and suckers.
The barbed head of a harpoon or spear.
The part of an anchor that catches in the ground.
A stroke of luck or an unexpected event, especially a surprising one.
examples: The sheep were infected with liver flukes.
He sharpened the flukes of the harpoon.
The anchor's flukes dug into the seabed.
Winning the lottery was a complete fluke.
